# Keys

Every key the reader answers to. The panes share one cursor, so a key aimed at
the diff works from the tree as well.

## Moving

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `j` / `k` | Down and up a row |
| `h` / `l` | Left to the tree, right to the diff |
| `tab` / `shift+tab` | The next and previous file |
| `n` / `N` | The next and previous hunk |
| `ctrl+d` / `ctrl+u` | Page the diff from either pane |

## Reading

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `r` | Mark the hunk under the cursor reviewed |
| `R` | Mark the whole file reviewed |
| `u` / `U` | Take that mark back |
| `space` | Fold the hunk |
| `p` | Read the whole file, changed lines still tinted |
| `v` | Select a range of lines |

## Writing

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `c` | Comment on the line, range, hunk or file |
| `e` | Edit the comment under the cursor |
| `x` | Delete it |
| `]` / `[` | The next and previous comment |
| `s` | Write the session note |

## Leaving

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `?` | The help sheet |
| `q` | Quit |
